spec: Semtech SX1262 on an SPI module covering 868 MHz, 22 dBm, IPEX or SMA. Ebyte E22-900M22S or Waveshare Core1262-868M or equivalent. Not SX1276, not LLCC68, and not the UART E22-900T22D.
why: Gives the DevKitC-based Node and Node-Satellite a LoRa radio on the doc 02 SPI pin map, so the proven firmware pinout does not move.

candidates.title: SX1262 LoRa Wireless Maodule 32M High Precision TCXO E22-900M22S 22dBm 915MHz Long Range SMD RF Module Power Supply
candidates.price_note: Free shipping confirmed on the page, so landed cost is 556 per module and 1112 for the pair. Title says 915MHz but the E22-900M22S is one part covering 850 to 930 MHz, so 868 is in band on the same hardware.
candidates.store: store 1103816042, trade name not exposed on the page
candidates.notes: Authenticity check on gallery images 1 and 2. Image 1 is a straight-on shot of the module label: CDEBYTE wordmark top left, EBYTE logo with the radio arcs, SPI SMD LoRa Module, part number E22-900M22S in large type, RoHS and CE marks, Manufacturer Chengdu Ebyte Electronic Technology Co. Ltd., FCC ID 2ALPH-E22900M22S, with the IPEX u.FL connector clearly on the lower right corner of the board and castellated stamp holes all round. Image 2 repeats it with dimensions 20.00mm by 14.00mm, which matches the Ebyte datasheet for the E22-900M22S. Caption reads SX1262 22dBm 7km. Genuine Ebyte part, SPI not UART, IPEX connector present as the spec wants. Cheapest of every SX1262 SPI module checked and the only one with free shipping, so it wins on landed price.

candidates.notes: Strongest trade record of the line, 800+ sold at a 5.0 rating over 101 reviews. Image 2 is the same family layout. So the part is genuine Ebyte silicon but the photography does not isolate the 900M22S, and the buyer must pick the 868 or 915 variant from the dropdown. Not chosen because shipping doubles the landed price against the free-shipping winner.

candidates.title: Waveshare Core1262-868M LoRa Module SX1262 Anti-Interference EU868 Band
candidates.price_note: The named Waveshare alternative from the spec. EU868 band is fixed in the part number, so there is no variant to get wrong.
candidates.notes: The only listing found whose part number pins the band to EU868 with no dropdown, which removes the single biggest ordering risk on this line. Waveshare Core1262 is a larger carrier board with an SMA or IPEX option and 0.1 inch headers, so it is easier to breadboard onto the DevKitC than a castellated Ebyte tile. Not chosen because it is 2.3 times the price of the winner and only 104 sold. Take it if the Ebyte band variant turns out not to be selectable at checkout. Photos not opened, so no silkscreen check was made.

candidates.store: store 5489003, trade name not exposed on the page
candidates.notes: Rejected on spec. The E22-900MM22S is the 10mm by 10mm ultra-small member of the family at 21.5 dBm, confirmed by the Ebyte family sheet seen while checking the runner-up, which lists E22-400MM22S and E22-900MM22S as the 10mm tile separate from the 20mm by 14mm E22-900M22S. It has no IPEX connector, only an antenna pad, and is a full dB down on output. Not the 22 dBm SPI module the spec asks for.
